outline:
本課程旨在介紹化學原理與物質性質相關之專業知識。下學期課程重點著重於分析化學、溶液特性，以及基礎化學理論與觀念之建立。內容涵蓋溶液性質、化學動力學、酸鹼平衡、緩衝溶液、沉澱反應、基礎有機化學、電化學及其相關應用。

This course introduces fundamental chemical principles and professional knowledge related to material properties. In the second semester, the course emphasizes analytical chemistry, solution characteristics, and the development of basic chemical theories and concepts. Topics covered include solution properties, chemical kinetics, acid–base equilibria, buffer solutions, precipitation reactions, introductory organic chemistry, electrochemistry, and their applications.
schedule:
第1-2週：Thermochemistry
第3-4週：Properties of Solutions
第5-6週：Chemical Equilibrium
第7-8週：Acids and Bases
第9-10週：Acid-Base Equilibria
第11-12週：Solubility and Complex Ion Equilibria
第13-14週：Electrochemistry
第15-16週：Chemical Kinetics
第17-18週：Organic Molecules
